name: Apple Pie
author: estoniancuisine.com
steps: Peel and clean apples/rhubarb, cut in to a slices
beat eggs and sugar together into a light foam
Mix together flour, salt and baking powder
Add  the dry ingredients to the egg mixture and add sour milk gradually while stirring,  Add berries.
Pour dough in to a butter greased pan. Sprinkle over sugar (and cinnamon). Bake at 180 C for 30 minute

culture.text: An apple pie is a fruit pie in which the principal filling is apples. It generally has shortcrust pastry both above and below the filling; the upper pastry may be solid or latticed. The bottom or pastry base may be baked separately to prevent it from getting soggy. Tarte Tatin is baked with the pastry on top, but this is served the opposite way round with the fruit exposed.
